name: autoclip
description: AutoClip｜一个链接，一键出片。开源 AI 视频剪辑桌面工具，将播客、访谈、课程等长视频自动剪成短视频，生成字幕、封面和发布文案，适配抖音、小红书、TikTok、Reels 与 YouTube Shorts。Open-source AI video clipping & content repurposing.
one_liner: Paste a link to a podcast or long video and this tool automatically cuts it into short clips with captions, a cover image, and ready-to-post captions for TikTok, Reels, and Shorts.
buyer: A podcaster or YouTuber who knows clipping is the best way to grow but doesn't have time to manually cut and caption every episode.
business_use_cases: A podcast producer runs every new episode through it automatically to get 5-10 short clips ready to post same-day.
A social media agency offers 'podcast-to-shorts repurposing' as a service to clients, using this tool to do the heavy lifting.
A solo creator turns long YouTube videos into a week's worth of daily shorts without hiring an editor.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a 'we clip your podcast every week' subscription service for creators, built on top of this tool.
White-label it as a feature inside a broader creator-tools SaaS, charging per minute of video processed.

steal_this: Offer 5 podcasters a free first batch of clips this weekend using this tool, then convert them to a $99/mo 'clip my show every week' service.
